title: Lohne Lancaster Memorial
memorial_details: Recently dedicated plaque at the crash site, Lohne, Wietmarschen, Niedersachsen. New 2026 memorial.
narrative: Lancaster DS718 of 408 (RCAF) Squadron, coded EQ-R, departed Linton-on-Ouse at 1722 on 29 December 1943 for Berlin. The aircraft was intercepted at 5000m by Oberleutnant Heinz-Wolfgang Schnaufer of 12/NJG1 and shot down at 1915, his 45th claim. All seven crew were killed.
cause_of_loss: Shot down by night fighter — Oblt Heinz-Wolfgang Schnaufer (12/NJG1), his 45th claim
